veranderings.voor: met verf op 'n rots aangebring is
veranderings.na: met verf op 'n rots geskilder is
veranderings.rede: 'Aangebring' is formal for Grade 5; 'geskilder' is plainer and matches the glossary definition of rotsskildery.
'Fynmaal' is a compound verb and is written as one word (AWS/HAT), so the past participle is 'fyngemaal'.
